saw_lines: People buy a remedy they already trust, then reorder it, often after a friend or a pharmacist recommends it.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a buyer decides if this product is for them.
Your same copy runs in 8 of 25 ads, so buyers see identical text again and again. Keep the copy and change the opening line and creative in each.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 15 Oct 2026
points: One exact copy runs in 8 of 25 ads, so the same people see the same message repeatedly. Keep the copy, but change the opening line and the creative in each ad, starting with the bee cream lines.
8 of 25 copy ads open on “endlich da: das neue immun-bienchen…” and the rest are single use, so no opener is tested against another. Test two new angles against it, dry winter hands and tired legs.
0 of 25 ads carry an offer, so a new buyer has no reason to act today. Give new buyers one reason to act now, a first order discount on bee cream, in line one of three new ads.

All 30 live ads say Shop now and link to 9 landing pages, several explaining a treatment rather than a product, so the click lands cold. Use Learn more on treatment pages and keep Shop now only for product pages.

ads_1: Fresh openers for bee cream and manuka hand cream, each with own visual
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube
